review.intent_summary: Adapt expectations to changing growth using bounded prior observations while preserving frozen calibration and isolating unusual values.

criteria.criterion: Each rolling expectation uses only observations before the sample being scored.
Persistent growth changes can be followed more closely than by the frozen default recipe.
An isolated extreme value is held out of future model references rather than creating a seasonal echo.
Conflicting trend choices and slope lookbacks exceeding the adaptive window are rejected.

verification_evidence: Manual source check confirmed rolling references exclude the scored index and respect the configured window.
Manual source check confirmed calibration center and scale are initialized once per segment and reused for evaluation scores.
Manual source check confirmed robust mode replaces isolated extremes with their expectations and admits the third consecutive same-direction extreme without resetting calibration.
Inspected all four focused tests, including comparative growth error and next-season echo assertions.
remaining_gaps: Automated checks were inspected but not rerun during this review.
